TCP::sendbuf
Description
This iRule command sets the TCP send buffer size in bytes.
Syntax
TCP
::
sendbuf
<
size
>
Examples
# Get the send buffer size of the TCP flow.
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.
"TCP set send buffer: [TCP::sendbuf 100000]"
log
local0.
"TCP get send buffer: [TCP::sendbuf]"
}
